items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It was Michael and me in tandem. What happened was, it was a gig.

ctx.x: Speaking of Meditations and other such, this brings us to the last of your ensembles, and that’s the Saxophone Summit, which is basically your creation, isn’t it?

It was Michael and me in tandem. What happened was, it was a gig. It was – the gig I did – described, with Wayne, it was in ’87. In ’97 they had Live at [by] the Sea – same promoter, I believe – kind of like Live under the Sky, that we did with Wayne. Coltrane wasn’t the center, but I think it was understood that there would be a Coltrane component, because it was the 30-year anniversary. It was supposed to be me, Michael, and Joe. I think Dave Holland’s there. Jack was there. That really good piano player I…
